en.title: This Bird's Pink Color Comes From Its Diet. Name It?
en.description: This is the roseate spoonbill. Like flamingos, its pink color comes from pigments in its food. It sweeps its spoon-shaped bill side to side through shallow water to sift out small prey, and plume hunting once nearly drove it to extinction.
